info.description:
Items, structures and follower skins from *Cult of the Lamb*, taken from the game (version 1.5.26.1058, captured 2026-10-29T04:51:32Z). Static JSON: no keys, no rate limits, open CORS. Within `v1/` fields are only added, never removed.

Unofficial fan project; the game, its data and art belong to Massive Monster and Devolver Digital. Source: [github.com/AuthFailed/cotl-api](https://github.com/AuthFailed/cotl-api).
